title: Tim Taylor disappears after 15 years of contact

tellings.quote: He just disappeared. We never heard from him since.

plain: A man named Timothy Taylor, after about fifteen years in touch with the family, simply vanished, according to the wife of Charles Hall, a man who says he spent three years among tall white aliens while serving with the Air Force. She tells it as something she lived through, in New Mexico: "He just disappeared. We never heard from him since." To her, the sudden silence of a long-time contact is part of the strangeness around her husband's story.
